prompt: The workspace holds a stripped x86-64 Linux binary, crackme, that checks a licence key given as its single argument (32 hex digits) and prints ACCEPTED or REJECTED. Exactly one key is accepted (up to letter case). Find it: analyse the binary with whatever run_python can drive (objdump, readelf, gdb and strace are on PATH; there is no source), invert its check, and confirm your key with the binary itself. Your FINAL message must contain the accepted key and no other 32-hex-digit string. Use the tools; when you are done, call submit.
trap: the key read straight from the Feistel inversion without undoing the nibble permutation of the parse (the binary REJECTS it)
